description: Cancel one queued or scheduled task by task_id; for all pending, use cancel_all. Use when: the user drops one task. Do not use to delay it (use postpone_task) or rerun a failed one (use retry_task). Behavior: marks it cancelled locally (no network) and redacts its prompt. Also cancels running and submitted tasks; a Batch call may still bill. A job or series skips this run; series=true ends it, even from a finished run. Else a finished task or repeat call changes nothing. Returns: "Task <id> status: <status>", terminated_at, and a job or series line when ended. Rejects an unknown task_id.

series.description: true also ends the job or series this task is a run of, so no further run is queued; use it for "stop this for good". Defaults to false: skip only this run; a job then plans its next one. No effect on a one-off task.

task_id.description: Id of the task to cancel, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the schedule_task reply or the check_queue_status list.

name: cancel_task
